description: Scan a folder of Markdown files and report its OKF v0.2 frontmatter tier: corpus tier (its weakest file), per-file tier, present fields, and the exact fields missing for each unreached tier, plus coverage per tier, a 0-100 score and a Merkle root of the corpus. Local and read-only.

name: jidoseal_scan
